name: Whippersnap
look: a low flat crab with a teal shell over a tan face, sleepy yellow eyes, white fangs, very long whip antennae, thin tan legs and short teal arms with hooked tan claws
entry: It looks half asleep, but its whip antennae never stop feeling around it. The moment one brushes prey, its little claws snap shut faster than the eye can follow.
how: Wild: uncommon in swamps, jungles and on beaches.
